Title: Aditya's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aditya - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 35 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Manoj - 36 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Riya - 12 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aditya (happily): "Careful!"

[Aditya climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Sonali: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Night

Riya: "What a nice place."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Aditya: "Careful!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Aditya: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 3: The park - Day

Sonali: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya catches the ball.]

Aditya (gently): "Really?"

[Aditya plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Aditya: "That was such a fun day!"
